turns.text: The school says if you hand out invitations in class you have to invite everyone. That's twenty eight kids.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a common rule to avoid hurt feelings. Do you want the whole class, or just a few close friends?

turns.speaker: moshi

turns.text: Right, next thing. I found three job postings I like and I can only realistically prepare properly for one this week.

turns.text: A marketing coordinator role at a small charity, lower pay but a mission I really care about.

turns.text: A junior brand manager job at a big drinks company, great salary and a long hiring process.

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: If you need income soon, the agency makes sense to prepare for first. If you can wait, the charity is the one you sound most excited about. I'd send the drinks company application now anyway, since that process will take weeks.
